sentence: This project builds an electronic test that detects nucleic acid from several respiratory pathogens at once without optics, fluorescent probes, or gels.
This project builds machine learning tools that study how populations diverge and adapt, using fruit flies, mosquitoes, plants, snails, and slugs.
This project develops a software platform that uses quantum computers to predict how candidate molecules bind to proteins.
This project studies how the 3D shape of DNA folded inside cells guides what cells do and tries to reshape it.
This project studies microbes in seafloor sediment cores to find out how they respond to more land-derived organic matter.
This project uses machine learning, device simulations, and nanoscale electrical measurements to find out what causes instability in perovskite solar cells.
This project builds electrochemical sensors that use nanoscale materials and molecular recognition switches to tell apart closely related small molecules.
This project compares how anther smut fungi infect different host plants, and why some plants fight off the same pathogens better.
This project builds a software platform that traces usability violations in web pages back to the source code and fixes them automatically.
This project designs brain-like computing hardware that uses stochastic magnetic devices to encode information in the temporal domain.
This project uses a legged robot to study how robots can explore unknown hazardous environments and help in search and rescue.
This project studies how microbes in the small intestine respond to bile acids and oxygen and protect against pathogens.
This project studies how diamond electrodes break down harmful pollutants called forever chemicals in drinking water.
This project studies how the cells of a social soil amoeba keep their development in step, using RNA sequencing and mutant strains.
This project builds a way for robots to learn tasks from demonstrations by combining neural networks with symbolic learning.
This project studies how attackers can manipulate natural language generation systems and builds defensive methods that reduce their vulnerabilities.
This project studies how genetics and childhood environment shape behaviors like anxiety and aggression in teenagers, and how their brains develop.
This project builds computational tools that predict what genes making non-protein coding RNA do in plant and animal cells, then tests the predictions.
